editorial: Imagine a single mother standing at the crossroads of fear and desperation. Monster pulls you into a claustrophobic tale where every glance feels weighted with secrets. Joaquin Phoenix carries each scene with almost no dialogue, allowing silence to amplify the unease. If you thrive on slow-burn tension and claustrophobic dread, this will find a home in your routine. At characters start to feel echoing, pacing dips slightly before the final act lifts the narrative.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
similarMovies: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
